# Shvintech

## About
Shvintech works with larger companies that need practical help moving their IT systems forward. They focus on DevOps practices, cloud migrations, data work and AI projects so teams can stop wrestling with old setups and start delivering faster. Their automation work cuts down on repetitive tasks while ERP implementations tie together the back office tools that keep operations running. IT staffing rounds out the offering when clients need experienced people on short notice rather than long hiring cycles.

**Areas of Work:** Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps, AI, Data & Automation, Software & Internet

## Products


## Services
- **DevOps Implementation** (Contact for quote): Helps teams adopt DevOps practices to speed up delivery and reduce friction in existing IT environments.
- **Cloud Migration Services** (Contact for quote): Assesses current setups and moves workloads to the right mix of public and private cloud resources.
- **Data Pipeline Development** (Contact for quote): Cleans messy datasets and builds reliable pipelines that support AI models without constant manual intervention.
- **ERP Implementation** (Contact for quote): Connects new ERP platforms with the rest of the tech stack to avoid creating isolated systems.
- **IT Staffing Support** (Contact for quote): Provides experienced specialists for short-term needs without the overhead of permanent hiring.
